fallen.last: The Hegemony sentry, Hugo Jameson, shouted once. Hugo Adamjedlicka silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@trey15jameson) Hugo Adamjedlicka threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Ivo Souptime was down and screaming for a medic. (@souptime13) Hugo Adamjedlicka made it into the enemy trench and out again. Twenty yards from home, a single shot ended it. Killed in the night raid by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745).

(@ay.den0707) Matthias Barontheliet joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. Clear weather exposed paths usually hidden by haze. Carrying parties waited for darkness rather than risk the open stretches.

115 new soldiers came up the line. Hegemony: @lorenzo_sapino_, @fransinlak, @acakostic11, @austintress, @deadeyesimulacrum, @matteozrybak, @galvanooooo, @carlingiti and 45 more. Bastian Wizzerd (@flying_wizzerd) spreads the word of the front further than any other soldier. The major named Bastian Wizzerd Propagandist of the Concord. "Together, or not at all," the posters say. The men believe it.

The Hegemony reached 300 soldiers first (300 against 257) and took Grey Mill. The deciding rifle belonged to @earn_e. The Hegemony dragged a heavy howitzer into a gun pit behind their line. From tomorrow it fires every day on the most crowded Concord trenches, until it is destroyed. Sappers keep it in repair. The race for the Bone Quarry begins now: the first side to bring 300 new soldiers takes it.

Today the first trench dogs came up the line. An Airedale, a German shepherd, Jack Russells, collies and a dachshund now sit beside their soldiers on both sides of the wire. Blue, Spot, Socks, Gyp, Ginger, Bess and Scout have already learned where the rations are kept. The men say a trench with a dog in it feels less like a grave.

The Concord holds the line with more men than the Hegemony, and still loses more of them. Half of its new soldiers came up this week and have not learned where to keep their heads. Crates of Hegemony ammunition come up Blackwater Canal every night, so their gunners never stop to count rounds. And the Concord medics cannot reach every stretcher: too many wounded, too few hands. Numbers alone do not hold a trench. Medics, gunners and luck do.
